name: Alter Simulacrum (Su)
body:
Prerequisite: Alchemist 10, alchemical simulacrum discovery

Benefit: The alchemist gains the ability to alter the physical appearance of any alchemical simulacrum he creates. This functions as a sculpt simulacrum spell. This process requires careful application, taking 10 minutes to complete and alchemical components worth 50 gp. The simulacrum cannot move and is considered helpless while being altered in this manner.
